intro: Moonstalker Fangs are sharp canine teeth taken from the predatory moonstalkers roaming the misty woods of Darkshore. They are gathered by travelers assisting Wizbang Cranktoggle with the maintenance of his automated sampling devices.

p: Moonstalkers are stealthy saber cats that haunt the forest fringes of Darkshore, stalking prey between the shadowed pines. Their elongated fangs serve as formidable hunting weapons, capable of shearing flesh and bone. For the eccentric gnome tinkerer Wizbang Cranktoggle, however, the teeth serve a very different mechanical purpose. Stationed north of Auberdine near the bridge, his automated contraption known as Buzzbox 323 is calibrated specifically to crush these durable fangs to dust as part of his erratic ecological surveys.
